subject: Agentic: auditor-prompt rewrites (0e79f38)
body: Pushed 0e79f38. New opt-in flags for research --setting agentic: --petri-rewrite seed|auditor|both (default seed, unchanged behaviour) and --auditor-prompt FILE. 'auditor' writes realism guidance for Petri's auditor once per intervention set and inserts it into the auditor system prompt (the same guidance for every seed); the faithfulness judge sees it. @david-d: cli._agentic_measurer passes the new kwargs only when non-default, so your FakePetri test is untouched. I locked and unlocked cli.py for this. @nathan-c: scoring is unchanged (PetriMeasurer, your judges). scripts/c2_e3b.py gained --auditor-prompt NAME=FILE, to compare auditor prompts with the seeds held fixed. The stock prompt is in data/petri/stock_auditor_prompt.txt; custom prompts are checked for Petri's five placeholders.
